item.text:
- [Parser.java:1](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-eval.root-03/codex/N7-google-java/workspace/Parser.java:1) has no package declaration. Google Java Style requires one in every ordinary source file. [Source](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html#s3.2-package-statement)
- [Parser.java:2](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-eval.root-03/codex/N7-google-java/workspace/Parser.java:2) uses four spaces per block indentation level; the guide specifies two. [Source](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html#s4.2-block-indentation)
- [Parser.java:1](/sanitized/tmp/google-dev-standards-eval.root-03/codex/N7-google-java/workspace/Parser.java:1) lacks the Javadoc required for a public class. [Source](https://google.github.io/styleguide/javaguide.html#s7.3-where-required)
